veranderings.blok: Die kaart is vol en jy soek een plek
veranderings.voor: Jy soek lank oor die hele bladsy
veranderings.na: Jy soek lank oral op die bladsy
veranderings.rede: 'Soek oor die bladsy' calques 'search over the page'; 'oral op die bladsy soek' is the natural Afrikaans, same word count.

veranderings.blok: Die kaart is vol en jy soek een plek
veranderings.voor: om te sê presies waar iets lê
veranderings.na: om presies te sê waar iets lê
veranderings.rede: In an om-te clause the adverb comes before 'te' and the infinitive; 'om te sê presies' follows English word order.

veranderings.blok: Die rooster verdeel die kaart in blokkies
veranderings.voor: van bo na onder en ander loop
veranderings.na: van bo na onder, en ander loop
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('Party lyne loop' / 'ander loop'), so a comma goes before it.

veranderings.voor: Kyk na die letter langs die kant wat by die dam se blokkie hoort
veranderings.na: Kyk watter letter langs die kant by die dam se blokkie hoort
veranderings.rede: The relative clause 'wat by die dam se blokkie hoort' attaches to 'die kant' instead of to the letter; the rewrite makes the letter the thing that belongs to the block, one word shorter.
For 'first, before something else' Afrikaans uses the adverb 'eers', as in the lesson's own title; 'eerste' here is an anglicism.

vlae.teks: Die blokkie waar die twee mekaar ontmoet, is waar die skool staan.
vlae.rede: 'Die twee' can only refer back to the letter and the number, but those do not meet; it is the row of the letter and the column of the number that cross. Fixing it would need wording about rows and columns that the lesson does not introduce, so it is flagged rather than changed.
